articles.title: Citi opens new route into private markets with tokenized share offering
articles.snippet: The bank said it is using blockchain technology to connect investors with private company equity through digital depositary receipts.

articles.title: Ondo Finance hires former Invesco ETF chief to build onchain investment products
articles.snippet: John Hoffman will spearhead Ondo's expansion from tokenizing individual assets to full investment portfolios and strategies.

articles.title: Japan’s parliament poised to pass sweeping bill to regulate crypto like stocks
articles.snippet: The new rules, which are expected to come into effect in 2027, aim to foster innovation and crypto market growth to meet internal and external demand for digital asset services.

articles.title: Singapore bank DBS to offer tokenized gold to retail customers
articles.snippet: Each token is backed by one gram of physical gold held by DBS in a dedicated vault in Singapore.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton, BNP Paribas see tokenization boosting EU's capital efficiency
articles.snippet: Executives from Franklin Templeton and BNP Paribas say tokenized assets and stablecoins could improve capital efficiency across Europe as Wall Street expands tokenization efforts.
